junk_imagery.evidence: hook@0.3 to payoff@-0.4 show only the chart, the leaderboard and the year counter. There are no photos, AI images or cutouts.

decorative_mascot.evidence: No mascot appears in any frame from hook@0.3 to payoff@-0.4, which is correct for this channel.

bare_number_card.evidence: Every beat shows the two lines growing and crossing (mid3, mid5). No beat is just a number on a background.

dead_air.evidence: The measured longest_static_s is 0.0. The lines, the year counter (2001 to 2024) and the axis rescale (mid3 250B to mid5 800B to 1400B) keep moving.

empty_void.evidence: The frame is a black ground, but the title, leaderboard, chart and counter fill it from top to bottom. In mid0 the right half of the plot is still empty while the lines draw in, but that space gets filled as they grow.

unreadable.evidence: The source line at the bottom of every frame (hook@0.3 to payoff@-0.4) is tiny dim gray text on black and can't be read on a phone at arm's length. In mid2 the 'Department stores 164.2B' label also sits close to the converging lines.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: The source attribution 'Source: U.S. Census Bureau Quarterly Retail E-Commerce Sales...' at the bottom is about 6px dim gray on black in every frame. The hook also opens on a static-feeling chart start with a boxed caption, not a strong motion beat.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The footer source text is rendered at a tiny size in a low-contrast gray. The hook relies on a text caption over a near-empty plot.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Render the source line at a phone-legible size (at least about 2.5% of frame height) in a higher-contrast gray, or shorten it to 'Source: U.S. Census Bureau'. Open the hook with the lines already moving toward the crossover.

depictions.note: Two-line race chart. The department stores line is sloping down and the e-commerce line is rising, but they have not crossed yet.
The crossover is marked with a ring and a 'passes' callout, so the overtake is visible without reading the numbers.
The axis rescale dramatizes e-commerce pulling away to 1192B while department stores stay flat.

grades.one_line: A clean, well-paced two-line race with a clearly marked crossover and a strong #1 payoff, but the footer source text is illegible on a phone.
problems: The source attribution footer is tiny, dim gray text that can't be read on a phone in any frame.
The hook opens on an almost empty plot with a text caption box instead of an immediate visual event.
In mid2 the 'Department stores 164.2B' label crowds the converging lines.
fixes: Enlarge the footer source text and raise its contrast, or shorten it to 'Source: U.S. Census Bureau'.
Start the hook with the lines already in motion, or tease the coming crossover in the first second.
Offset the trailing label away from the line crossing so it never overlaps the lines.
